# FPS+ 1.0.1

- Prevents a previous widget tap from being replayed when the activity is recreated, such as during a rotation.
- Licenses FPS+ source and original artwork under GNU GPL version 3 only; includes the GPL text and third-party license notices in the APK.
- Keeps all functionality from 1.0 and uses the same release signing key, so Android can install it over 1.0.

The release build, Android Lint vital checks, and six unit tests passed. Widget behavior in this build has not been tested on a physical phone. Setting the property does not automatically confirm that interpolation is working in a game.

The APK checksum is provided in `FPS-plus-1.0.1-SHA256SUMS.txt`.
